metadata.title: Environment Departments, Pollution Control Authorities & Conservation Centers of Pune
agencies_included: National Green Tribunal (NGT Western Zone Bench)
Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB Regional & Sub-Regional Offices)
Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC Environment Department, Indradhanushya, Tree Authority & Zoo)
Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC Environment Engineering & Tree Authority)
Maharashtra Forest Department (Territorial Pune Division, Van Bhavan & Social Forestry Directorate)
Botanical Survey of India (BSI Western Regional Centre)
Zoological Survey of India (ZSI Western Regional Centre)
Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM SAFAR Air Quality HQ)
India Meteorological Department (IMD Climate Research & Environmental Services)
Central Water and Power Research Station (CWPRS Environmental Hydraulics)
Maharashtra Energy Development Agency (MEDA Renewable Energy & Climate Action HQ)
Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Stations (CAAQMS Network across Pune & PCMC)

properties.name: National Green Tribunal (NGT) – Western Zone Bench, Pune
properties.agency: National Green Tribunal (NGT), Ministry of Law and Justice / MoEFCC, Govt of India
properties.address: 1st Floor, B-Wing, New Administrative Building, Opposite Council Hall, Bund Garden Road, Camp, Pune – 411001
properties.jurisdiction: Statutory judicial forum handling environmental litigations, enforcement of legal rights relating to environment, relief and compensation for damages to persons and property, forest conservation, coastal management, and pollution cases across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, and UTs of Daman, Diu, Dadra & Nagar Haveli.

properties.name: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) – Regional Office Pune
properties.agency: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB), Environment Department, Govt. of Maharashtra
properties.address: 3rd Floor, Jog Centre, Mumbai-Pune Road, Wakdewadi, Pune – 411003
properties.jurisdiction: Regional regulatory enforcement of Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act 1974, Air (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act 1981, Hazardous Waste Rules, Biomedical Waste Rules, and Plastic Waste Management Rules across Pune district.

properties.name: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) – Sub-Regional Office Pune-I
properties.agency: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB)
properties.address: 3rd Floor, Jog Centre, Mumbai-Pune Road, Wakdewadi, Pune – 411003
properties.jurisdiction: Inspection, sampling, and consent to establish/operate for industries, healthcare establishments, and infrastructure projects in Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) area, Daund, Indapur, Baramati, Purandar, Bhor, and Velhe talukas.

properties.name: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) – Sub-Regional Office Pune-II
properties.agency: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB)
properties.address: 3rd Floor, Jog Centre, Mumbai-Pune Road, Wakdewadi, Pune – 411003
properties.jurisdiction: Regulatory oversight of industrial estates in Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC), Haveli, Khed (Chakan MIDC), Ambegaon, Junnar, Shirur (Ranjangaon MIDC), and Maval (Talegaon MIDC).

properties.name: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) – Environment Department (पर्यावरण विभाग)
properties.agency: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC)
properties.address: 2nd Floor, Room No. 209/210, PMC Main Administrative Building, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411005
properties.jurisdiction: Preparation of the mandatory annual Environmental Status Report (ESR), implementation of Pune Climate Action Plan (CAP), urban heat island mitigation, air pollution reduction action plan, sound level monitoring during festivals, lake rejuvenation, and e-waste management.

properties.name: Indradhanushya Environment Education & Citizenship Centre (PMC)
properties.agency: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) – Environment Department
properties.address: Opposite Sachin Tendulkar Jogging Park, Anant Kanhere Path, Near Mhatre Bridge, Rajendra Nagar, Navi Peth, Dattawadi, Pune – 411030
properties.jurisdiction: Interactive public environment museum, citizen outreach, Majhi Vasundhara Abhiyan nodal cell, urban biodiversity documentation, school environmental camps, and renewable energy live demonstration models.

properties.name: Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC) – Environment Engineering Department
properties.agency: Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC)
properties.address: 2nd Floor, PCMC Main Administrative Building, Old Mumbai-Pune Highway, Pimpri Colony, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune – 411018
properties.jurisdiction: Industrial and urban pollution monitoring, continuous ambient air monitoring, river water quality testing along Pavana and Indrayani rivers, sewage treatment plants (STP) operation, bio-mining, and PCMC environmental status reporting.

properties.name: PMC Riverfront Development & Pollution Abatement Project Department (Mula-Mutha Rejuvenation)
properties.agency: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) / JICA (Japan International Cooperation Agency)
properties.address: PMC Main Administrative Building, Shivaji Nagar, Pune – 411005
properties.jurisdiction: Execution of the JICA-assisted Mula-Mutha River Pollution Abatement Project; construction of 11 intermediate sewage treatment plants (STPs), 113 km of interceptor sewer networks, and riparian buffer ecological restoration.

properties.name: Maharashtra Forest Department – Office of the Conservator of Forests (Territorial) & DCF Pune (Van Bhavan)
properties.agency: Maharashtra Forest Department, Government of Maharashtra
properties.address: Van Bhavan, Bhamburda Van Vihar, Gokhalenagar - Vetal Hill Road, Gokhalenagar, Pune – 411016
properties.jurisdiction: Management and conservation of reserved forests, wildlife sanctuaries, urban hill ecosystems (Vetal Tekdi, Taljai, ARAI), anti-poaching squads, human-leopard conflict mitigation in rural Pune, and afforestation programs.

properties.name: Office of the Principal Chief Conservator of Forests (Social Forestry) Maharashtra State
properties.agency: Social Forestry Directorate, Maharashtra Forest Department
properties.address: Central Building, Ground Floor, Station Road, Agarkar Nagar, Pune – 411001
properties.jurisdiction: Statewide headquarters for social forestry, afforestation on non-forest wastelands, canal-side and roadside tree corridors, green belt development in urban perimeters, and farmer agroforestry.

properties.name: Botanical Survey of India (BSI) – Western Regional Centre, Pune
properties.agency: Botanical Survey of India, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
properties.address: 7, Koregaon Road, Sangamvadi, Pune – 411001
properties.jurisdiction: Exploration, inventory, taxonomic research, and conservation of endangered, endemic, and economic plant species in the Western Ghats biodiversity hotspot, Maharashtra, Goa, and Gujarat; maintains regional botanical museum and herbarium.

properties.name: Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) – Western Regional Centre, Pune
properties.agency: Zoological Survey of India, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
properties.address: Western Regional Station, Sector 29, Rawet Road, Near Akurdi Railway Station, PCNTDA, Akurdi, Pune – 412101
properties.jurisdiction: Faunal explorations, taxonomic research, ecological assessments of Western Ghats invertebrate and vertebrate species, wildlife forensics, and biodiversity database documentation.

properties.name: Rajiv Gandhi Zoological Park & Wildlife Research Centre (Katraj Zoo)
properties.agency: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) – Environment Wing / Central Zoo Authority (CZA)
properties.address: Pune - Satara Road, Opposite Katraj Dairy, Katraj, Pune – 411046
properties.jurisdiction: Ex-situ conservation breeding of endangered native fauna (Royal Bengal Tiger, Indian Leopard, King Cobra), wildlife rescue transit center, Katraj lake wetland management, and public environmental education.

properties.name: PMC Tree Authority & Garden Department (वृक्ष प्राधिकरण मुख्य कार्यालय)
properties.agency: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC)
properties.address: Chhatrapati Sambhajiraje Udyan Office, Jangali Maharaj Road, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411004
properties.jurisdiction: Statutory authority under Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act; processing tree felling and trimming permissions, geo-tagged tree census (over 4 million trees mapped), urban public garden upkeep, and indigenous tree planting.

properties.name: PCMC Tree Authority & Garden Department (वृक्ष प्राधिकरण PCMC)
properties.agency: Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC)
properties.address: PCMC Main Administrative Building, Old Mumbai-Pune Highway, Pimpri, Pune – 411018
properties.jurisdiction: Enforcement of Tree Protection Act, conservation of industrial green belts, avenue plantation along BRTS corridors, and urban park ecosystems across Pimpri-Chinchwad.

properties.name: PMRDA – Environment, Lake Conservation & Tree Authority Department
properties.agency: Pune Metropolitan Region Development Authority (PMRDA)
properties.address: Maharaja Sayajirao Gaikwad Udyog Bhavan, Survey No. 152-153, Aundh Gaon, Aundh, Pune – 411067
properties.jurisdiction: Environmental clearance compliance reviews for town planning schemes, preservation of wetlands and rural waterbodies, environmental buffer zoning along rivers and hills, and tree protection across the 7,256 sq km PMR jurisdiction.

properties.name: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM) – Air Quality & SAFAR Headquarters
properties.agency: Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), Government of India
properties.address: Dr. Homi Bhabha Road, Pashan, Pune – 411008
properties.jurisdiction: Premier national atmospheric science institution; designer, developer, and nodal control center for the SAFAR (System of Air Quality and Weather Forecasting and Research) network; emission inventory modeling, aerosol physics, and monsoon climate change projections.

properties.name: India Meteorological Department (IMD) – Climate Research & Environmental Services (Shimla Office)
properties.agency: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences
properties.address: Ganeshkhind Road, Revenue Colony, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411005
properties.jurisdiction: National climate monitoring and diagnostic services, historical climate data archives, atmospheric turbidity and solar radiation measurements, urban meteorology, and climate risk assessments.

properties.name: Central Water and Power Research Station (CWPRS) – River & Environmental Hydraulics Division
properties.agency: Department of Water Resources, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
properties.address: Sinhagad Road, Khadakwasla, Pune – 411024
properties.jurisdiction: Hydraulic physical and mathematical modeling, environmental impact studies for river basin projects, water quality modeling in estuaries and reservoirs, and thermal discharge dispersion studies.

properties.name: Maharashtra Energy Development Agency (MEDA) – Renewable Energy & Climate Action HQ
properties.agency: Department of Energy, Government of Maharashtra
properties.category: State Clean Energy & Climate Action Agency
properties.address: Aundh Road, Opposite Spicer College Road, Aundh, Pune – 411067
properties.jurisdiction: Implementation of Maharashtra State Renewable Energy Policy, grid-connected solar rooftop initiatives, wind power, biomass gasification, carbon mitigation strategies, and energy conservation building codes (ECBC).

properties.name: Agharkar Research Institute (ARI) – Environmental Sciences & Microbial Diversity Division
properties.agency: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India
properties.address: Agarkar Road, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411004
properties.jurisdiction: Applied scientific research on bio-remediation of heavy metals and pollutants, microbial fuel cells, bio-energy, National Facility for Culture Collection of Fungi (NFCCI), and paleontological climate proxies.

properties.name: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Station (CAAQMS) – Shivajinagar (IMD)
properties.agency: MPCB / CPCB / IITM-SAFAR
properties.address: IMD Weather Observatory Campus, Ganeshkhind Road, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411005
properties.jurisdiction: Continuous real-time sampling and public broadcasting of National Air Quality Index (AQI), PM2.5, PM10, Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2), Sulfur Dioxide (SO2), Carbon Monoxide (CO), and Ozone (O3).

properties.name: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Station (CAAQMS) – Karve Road (Erandwane)
properties.agency: MPCB / CPCB / IITM-SAFAR
properties.sub_category: High-Density Traffic Corridor Air Quality Station
properties.address: Near Karve Putala, Karve Road, Erandwane, Pune – 411004
properties.jurisdiction: Continuous monitoring of roadside traffic emissions, vehicular particulate matter (PM2.5/PM10), volatile organic compounds (VOCs), and nitrogen oxides along the Karve Road transit corridor.

properties.name: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Station (CAAQMS) – Bhosari MIDC
properties.agency: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) / CPCB
properties.address: Nehrunagar / Sector 10, MIDC Bhosari, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune – 411026
properties.jurisdiction: Continuous surveillance of industrial air emissions, boiler flue particulates, sulfur dioxide, ammonia, and chemical smog indicators in the northern manufacturing hub.

properties.name: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Station (CAAQMS) – Hadapsar
properties.agency: IITM-SAFAR / MPCB
properties.address: Magarpatta City / Hadapsar, Pune – 411013
properties.jurisdiction: Automated 24x7 monitoring of fine particulates and gaseous pollutants across eastern suburban and IT industrial corridors.

properties.name: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Station (CAAQMS) – Pashan (IITM)
properties.agency: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM) / MoES
properties.sub_category: Regional Background Air Quality Reference Station
properties.address: IITM Atmospheric Observatory Campus, Dr. Homi Bhabha Road, Pashan, Pune – 411008
properties.jurisdiction: Reference calibration station providing clean-air baseline benchmarks, long-range aerosol transport tracking, and atmospheric optical depth measurements.

properties.name: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Station (CAAQMS) – Katraj
properties.agency: IITM-SAFAR / MPCB
properties.address: Bharati Vidyapeeth Campus, Pune - Satara Road, Katraj, Pune – 411046
properties.jurisdiction: Monitoring of vehicular dust, diesel exhaust particulates, and transit emissions entering Pune from the southern NH-48 corridor.

properties.name: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Station (CAAQMS) – Alandi
properties.agency: IITM-SAFAR / MPCB
properties.sub_category: Peri-Urban & River Basin Air Quality Station
properties.address: Alandi Devachi, Near Indrayani River, Pune – 412105
properties.jurisdiction: Environmental monitoring of ambient air and microclimatic parameters along the Indrayani River basin in northern peri-urban Pune.
